notes.title: Radical Road 1.0 Released!
notes.content:
[b]Radical Road is released on steam! What a momentus day![/b]

I just really want to thank all of my friends who have helped me with various things alongside the development of this game. Could not have done it without you <3

And on the off chance that someone i don't know personally finds and picks up Radical Road, i hope you enjoy yourself! It may not look like much, but i have put a lot of heart and soul into this seemingly non-complicated game.

Stay Radical
-Krispy
